A7Analogue

Noise

Analogue noise with tone control

Generates white noise plus a second output with adjustable colour, from dark rumble to bright hiss.

  • COLOR can be controlled by CV
  • Sound source for snares, wind and surf
  • Slowly filtered, it doubles as a random source
